name: Symbol Slider
description: Generates different types of symbol sliders as entities.
project_description:
The symbol Slider entity type is a custom entity type that allow you to add symbols with many sliders type option in the content. This module is used to create a different type of symbol slider.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Download and extract files in the module folder. 
 Enable module from the modules list. 
 Go to administration menu >> symbol slider >> click on add new symbol. 
 Fill the fields name, slider type, image and then click on save. 
 Here clear your Drupal cache. 
 Now navigate to administration menu >> structure >> block layout. 
 Now go to the block layout structure admin >> structure >> block to find out your slider block and place on region where you want to show that slider.
